    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectFeedback" name="Collect feedback from testing phase">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToFeedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackToRefineGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" name="Refinement needed?" default="Flow_NoRefinement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackToRefineGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefinementNeeded</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoRefinement</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefinePrototype" name="Refine prototype">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefinementNeeded</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefineToTestEntry</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Outcome" name="Prototype approved or discarded?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoRefinement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToApprove</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToDiscard</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApprovePrototype" name="Approve prototype for further development">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToApprove</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApproveToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DiscardPrototype" name="Discard prototype">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToDiscard</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DiscardToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approved" name="Prototype approved for further development">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApproveToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Discarded" name="Prototype discarded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DiscardToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToIdentify" sourceRef="StartEvent_IdeaIdentified" targetRef="Task_IdentifyIdea"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IdentifyToResearch" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyIdea" targetRef="Task_ConductResearch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResearchToFeasibility" sourceRef="Task_ConductResearch" targetRef="Task_ConductFeasibility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeasibilityToDesign" sourceRef="Task_ConductFeasibility" targetRef="Task_DraftDesigns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DesignToSelect" sourceRef="Task_DraftDesigns" targetRef="Task_SelectDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToBuild" sourceRef="Task_SelectDesign" targetRef="Task_BuildPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildToTestEntry" sourceRef="Task_BuildPrototype" targetRef="Gateway_TestEntry"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefineToTestEntry" sourceRef="Task_RefinePrototype" targetRef="Gateway_TestEntry"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestEntryToSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_TestEntry" targetRef="Gateway_TestSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToFunctionality" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSplit" targetRef="Task_AssessFunctionality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToSafety" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSplit" targetRef="Task_AssessSafety"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToMarket" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSplit" targetRef="Task_AssessMarketPotential"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FunctionalityToJoin" sourceRef="Task_AssessFunctionality" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SafetyToJoin" sourceRef="Task_AssessSafety" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MarketToJoin" sourceRef="Task_AssessMarketPotential" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToFeedback" sourceRef="Gateway_TestJoin" targetRef="Task_CollectFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToRefineGateway" sourceRef="Task_CollectFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefinementNeeded" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" targetRef="Task_RefinePrototype">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refinementNeeded == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoRefinement" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" targetRef="Gateway_Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToApprove" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="Task_ApprovePrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToDiscard" name="Discarded" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="Task_DiscardPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApproveToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ApprovePrototype" targetRef="EndEvent_Approved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DiscardToEnd" sourceRef="Task_DiscardPrototype" targetRef="EndEvent_Discarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
